actions.action: Behead the plant by cutting the stem below the top rosette with a clean knife
Let the cutting callus in dry air for 3-7 days
Set the callused cutting on dry cactus mix and mist/water sparingly once roots appear
Keep the stump in its pot and water it lightly so it sprouts new rosettes
Pull off healthy lower leaves, callus them, and lay them on soil to propagate
Move the plant to a spot with 4-6 hours of direct sun, such as a south-facing window
Alternatively, buy and set up a full-spectrum grow light
Rotate the pot a quarter turn weekly
Repot into gritty succulent mix amended with perlite or pumice
Water deeply only when the soil is completely dry
Acclimate the plant gradually to stronger sun over 1-2 weeks

reason: The answer correctly diagnoses etiolation and recommends beheading, propagating leaves, repotting and giving more light, matching the thread's fix with nothing harmful; it suggests a south window rather than east but includes acclimation.
